Stage 5 · Java foundations

Constructors: Birth Rituals

Name + starting values in ONE call. No half-built objects.

⏱ 14 min🧠 No experience needed🧪 Interactive
Step 1

Valid at birth

Stamp title once, valid forever after.

🍼

Birth certificates. Hand name + data ONCE → valid citizen. new Book("Dune") stamps at birth. Later edits go through methods, not rebirth.

Three births
class Book {
  String title;
  boolean borrowed;
  Book() { this("Untitled"); }            // chains below
  Book(String t) { title = t; }           // main birth
  Book(String t, boolean b) {             // full birth
    title = t;
    borrowed = b;
  }
}
new Book();               // "Untitled", free
new Book("Dune");        // Dune, free
new Book("1984", true);  // 1984, borrowed
No return type — not even void. Overloads by arguments; this(...) chains first line.
